Abstract excerpt: Foundation models (FMs) increasingly support multimodal and geospatial reasoning, yet it remains unclear whether cartographic principles designed for human perception are equally effective for machines. Focusing on sequential choropleth maps, we examine how hue palette, color ordering, and lightness contrast influence FM spatial reasoning.
